title: Sarcoglaucone A, a novel sarsolenane-related diterpenoid from the soft coral Sarcophyton glaucum
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9224-9232
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09073C, Paper

Yue-Wen Chuang, Atallah F. Ahmed, Hsiao-Ling Chung, Yueh-Wen Liu, Su-Ying Chien, Yu-Chi Lin, Chia-Ching Liaw, Yu-Jen Wu, Jing-Ru Weng, Quoc Vu Pham, Jui-Hsin Su, Jyh-Horng Sheu, Ping-Jyun Sung
Two sarsolenane-type diterpenoids, including a known compound, dihydrosarsolenone (1), and a novel metabolite, sarcoglaucone A (2), were isolated from the soft coral Sarcophyton glaucum, collected off the coast of Taiwan.
